entry.title: Town Meeting: the meeting of 3 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Town meeting approved the school department's full state-aid request over a select-board bid to cut it. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UgUpJJb4cPw), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
